caption:
Two metallic coil springs settle toward a pale, finely textured surface, each above a dark circular ring marking fixed on the surface. A blurred teal-green backdrop fills the upper view behind a soft curved horizon. Already mid-process, the springs hold tall, open coils and lean slightly as they settle downward.

As the motion advances, both springs shorten vertically: the upper coils descend toward the lower turns, and the spacing between successive coils steadily narrows. The two springs behave alike but not in lockstep, each gradually changing its lean as the top shifts sideways relative to its base. Their lower ends remain roughly aligned with the ring markings. Meanwhile the curved horizon and the spring bases drift downward, a slow camera tilt superimposed on the settling motion.

By the later moments the springs are markedly slumped and tilted, their coils packed tighter than at the start, yet the compression is still underway rather than resolved.
